metadata.purpose: Describe how a student actually applies after eligibility/documents are understood.
critical_distinctions: Eligibility is not the same as successful application submission.
Successful submission is not the same as verification.
Verification is not the same as final scholarship selection/award.
Application-process steps can change each cycle; use current source metadata.

application_process.scholarship_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
application_process.registration_method: NSP One Time Registration (OTR) using Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrolment ID
application_process.correction_after_final_submit: Scheme/portal dependent; do not assume edits are allowed after final submit.

process_steps.action: Generate or use existing One Time Registration (OTR).
process_steps.details: OTR is Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrolment ID based and is valid for the student's academic career.

process_steps.action: Login to NSP using OTR ID and password.
process_steps.details: Fresh and renewal applications are handled from the student login/dashboard.

process_steps.action: Check scholarship eligibility / select the applicable scheme.
process_steps.details: Choose the correct fresh or renewal application and scheme.
Enter personal, academic, domicile/category/income/bank and scheme-specific information.

process_steps.action: Upload or provide required scheme documents/details.
process_steps.details: Upload/enter the documents and evidence requested for that scholarship.
Check scheme, profile, bank and document information before final submission.
Submission sends the application into the NSP verification workflow.

process_steps.action: Application is verified by the institution and designated authorities.
process_steps.details: Institute and higher-level verification deadlines/statuses are separate from student submission.
Use the student login/dashboard to check application progress.
NSP links students to PFMS/payment tracking for disbursement status.

application_process.tracking_method: NSP student dashboard; PFMS for payment tracking where applicable
application_process.renewal_process: Login with OTR → select Renewal → update/confirm current-year information → upload required renewal documents → final submit.
application_process.notes: For AY 2026-27, the currently surfaced CSSS application is renewal; choose Renewal rather than Fresh.
